source_title: 25 In-the-Know Gifts for Women: Mahjong Boards, ACOTAR Merch, Nathan Fielder Lingerie and More
source_excerpt:
If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, Variety may receive an affiliate commission.
Shopping for the women in your life is easy enough if you’re sticking to the usual suspects: a cashmere sweater, a luxury fragrance, a pair of designer sunglasses. But what about the friend who thinks Nathan Fielder is the hottest man alive? Or the one who’d rather spend Friday night watching “Gone With the Wind” than going out?
This year’s gift guide goes beyond the predictable, with picks for every type of woman on your list — including the cinephile who’d appreciate A24’s encyclopedia of movie cats, the industry insider eyeing a tee from George Lucas’ new museum and the theater kid who still knows every word to “Hamilton” (and would happily spin all seven records of its new anniversary vinyl box set). There’s even a Nathan Fielder thong, because some gifts are simply too specific to pass up… Related Stories 'Wanted' Broadway Review: Dazzling Cast Can't Elevate the Musical’s Muted Narrative 'A Few Good Men' Review: Broadway Revival Breathes New Life Into Aaron Sorkin's Courtroom Classic

'A Few Good Men' Review: Broadway Revival Breathes New Life Into Aaron Sorkin's Courtroom Classic
Shop a few of the best gifts for women in 2026 below:
A24’s 420-page hardcover celebrates cinema’s most memorable felines, featuring more than 1,000 cats and 1,900 film stills, from Holly Golightly’s orange tabby in “Breakfast at Tiffany’s” to Jonesy in “Alien.”
These luxe cashmere pants from Nüülee are an elevated alternative to traditional sweatpants, offering the comfort of loungewear with a more polished look. Pair them with the brand’s matching cashmere sweater for a complete set.
Nathan Fielder is officially the internet’s latest unlikely sex symbol, thanks to his scene-stealing appearance in the Elizabeth Holmes documentary “You Can See Everything.” For anyone newly converted to the comedian’s sex appeal, this thong bearing his face is the ultimate gag gift.
A stylish gift for the film buff, this 100% cotton tee features vintage-inspired varsity lettering from George Lucas’ just-opened Lucas Museum of Narrative Art in Los Angeles.
Fronted by Dakota Johnson and Alexander Skarsgård in a steamy campaign directed by Romain Gavras, Valentino’s new Vendetta Donna fragrance combines tuberose with notes of blood orange and creamy sandalwood.
Legendary makeup artist Pat McGrath brings her signature artistry to Louis Vuitton’s luxury beauty line, featuring richly pigmented lipsticks, eyeshadow palettes and balms housed in collectible, refillable packaging.
Copenhagen cool meets performance wear in Ganni and Lululemon’s 22-piece collaboration, which reimagines workout staples with leopard prints, ruffled trims and ’80s dance-inspired silhouettes.
More than a decade after “Not That Kind of Girl” and ahead of the forthcoming “Girls” reboot (!!), the “voice of a generation” returned with a candid memoir about fame, chronic illness, addiction and her often-complicated relationships, including her years with musician Jack Antonoff.
Amazon’s premium color e-reader features a seven-inch display that brings book covers, illustrations and highlighted passages to life, plus 32GB of storage and wireless charging for readers who never leave home without a book.
Sarah J. Maas’ bestselling fantasy series gets a romantic fashion makeover with For Love & Lemons’ collection of whimsical dresses and lingerie inspired by Prythian’s Spring Court, Night Court, Starfall celebrations and Valkyries.
Andy’s Bravo Scrapbook: Twenty Years Behind the Scenes of the Real Housewives and the Bravoverse
Andy Cohen opens his personal archives for this 320-page coffee-table book, featuring more than 600 behind-the-scenes photos and untold stories from two decades of “Real Housewives” reunions and Bravo history.
For the woman whose ideal Friday night involves a good movie and absolutely no plans, Cozy Earth’s ultra-plush Cuddle Blanket makes an inviting addition to her couch. Made from soft faux fur, the oversized throw is a particularly cozy gift for the colder months.
For the Emma Chamberlain devotee, J.Crew’s newly reimagined Rollneck sweater is an easy wardrobe upgrade. The ’80s staple gets a Gen Z makeover with a shrunken, slightly cropped silhouette, as seen in Chamberlain’s playful, early-internet-inspired campaign.
For the fashion girl who prioritizes both comfort and style, Salomon’s cult-favorite XT-6 sneakers are a worthwhile addition to her collection. Beloved by celebrities including Bella Hadid and Emily Ratajkowski, the trail-inspired shoes feature Gore-Tex waterproofing for year-round wear.
For the woman who prefers to hide behind a pair of shades, you can’t go wrong with Ray-Ban’s classic Wayfarers. The timeless frames have counted everyone from Madonna and Kate Moss to Rihanna among their celebrity fans.
For the classic Hollywood obsessive, this brand new Blu-ray edition of the 1939 epic starring Vivien Leigh and Clark Gable makes a fitting addition to any film collection, bringing the Oscar-winning production to home screens.
Celebrating 10 years of Lin-Manuel Miranda’s Broadway phenomenon, this seven-LP collection brings together the original “Hamilton” cast recording, “The Hamilton Mixtape” and “Hamildrops: The Complete Collection,” including the latter’s physical debut.
For anyone inspired by CBK’s minimal style in “Love Story,” this simple hair clip offers polished upgrade to the everyday accessory. The Alexandre de Paris barrette features a sculptural knot-inspired design that adds a touch of French elegance to even the simplest hairstyle.
Mahjong is having a major moment, with the traditional tile game finding a new generation of fans through stylish game nights, social clubs and celebrity enthusiasts. Oh My Mahjong’s colorful bundle makes an ideal gift for anyone looking to get in on the trend and host a game night of her own.
Bring the skincare clinic home with Omnilux’s flexible LED mask, which uses red and near-infrared light to help reduce the appearance of fine lines and improve skin firmness. Its 10-minute treatments make it an easy addition to a nighttime skincare routine.
nodpod Mineralized Silk Gentle Pressure Sleep Mask
This weighted sleep mask combines the calming pressure of nodpod’s signature design with mineralized silk, treated with silver ions that help fight acne-causing bacteria. It’s a thoughtful upgrade for anyone serious about her beauty sleep.
For the wellness enthusiast who loves tracking everything from her sleep to her daily activity, Oura’s newest smart ring is a practical luxury. Released in October, the fifth-generation model features a slimmer, all-titanium design and upgraded sensors for monitoring health metrics without the bulk of a smartwatch.
For the homebody who likes to look put-together even when she’s staying in, Skims’ matching pajama set makes a reliably comfortable gift. The soft, relaxed-fit design features a classic button-up top with piping details and coordinating drawstring pants, perfect for slow mornings and movie nights.
A crafty artist on Etsy is like a kid in a candy shop. The ecommerce platform has everything from handmade jewelry to custom art to vintage homeware, but if you don’t know where to start you can’t go wrong with a gift card.
Simplehuman is without a doubt the sleekest compost bin on the market, with a magnetic docking system that lets you hang it off the side of your trash bin and a slim enough design to leave it on the counter. A soft-seal lid minimizes the odor from food scraps and keeps pests like fruit flies away, while the caddy’s stainless steel exterior is coated with Agion, an antimicrobial that inhibits the growth of bacteria and fungi. Plus, the brand comes with their own line of compostable liners that fit the bin perfectly for effortless removal.
